message.content:
{
  "page_id": "page-01",
  "page_type": "dashboard",
  "page_name": "InsurIntel AI Dashboard",
  "purpose": "An AI-powered underwriting workflow interface that allows insurance professionals to analyze policy documents, extract clauses, and ask specific questions about risk factors and contract details.",
  "navigation_to": ["Product", "Solutions", "Pricing", "Resources", "Login", "Get Started"],
  "color_palette": {
    "background": "#F8FAFC",
    "surface": "#FFFFFF",
    "text_primary": "#0F172A",
    "text_secondary": "#64748B",
    "accent": "#1D4ED8",
    "border": "#E2E8F0"
  },
  "typography": {
    "heading_font": "Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif",
    "body_font": "Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif",
    "heading_size_px": 20,
    "body_size_px": 14,
    "heading_weight": 600,
    "body_weight": 400
  },
  "layout": {
    "max_width_px": 1440,
    "container": "grid",
    "columns": 2,
    "header_present": true,
    "footer_present": false,
    "sidebar_present": true,
    "sections": ["header", "workflow_breadcrumb", "main_content_area", "sidebar_panel"]
  },
  "header": {
    "present": true,
    "logo_text": "InsurIntel AI",
    "nav_items": ["Product", "Solutions", "Pricing", "Resources"],
    "right_side": ["Login", "Get Started"],
    "background_color": "#FFFFFF",
    "sticky": false
  },
  "hero": {
    "present": false
  },
  "content_sections": [
    {
      "name": "Workflow Breadcrumb",
      "type": "steps",
      "heading": "",
      "subheading": "",
      "items": [
        {"label": "Home", "icon": "home-circle"},
        {"label": "Selection", "icon": "target"},
        {"label": "Recommendation", "icon": "lightbulb"},
        {"label": "Comparison", "icon": "scale"},
        {"label": "Deep Dive", "icon": "magnifier"},
        {"label": "Final Decision", "icon": "check-circle-filled"}
      ],
      "layout": "horizontal-steps"
    },
    {
      "name": "AI Chat Interface",
      "type": "content_blocks",
      "heading": "",
      "subheading": "",
      "items": [
        {
          "role": "assistant",
          "avatar": "bot-icon-blue",
          "content": "I've analyzed the uploaded Commercial General Liability (CGL) policy for Global Logistics Corp.",
          "sub_content_label": "Key observations for your review:",
          "bullet_points": [
            "Aggregate limit is capped at $5,000,000, consistent with industry standards for this sector.",
            "Exclusion clause 4.b (Cyber Risk) is broader than standard forms; may require a separate cyber endorsement."
          ],
          "actions": ["Helpful", "Copy"]
        },
        {
          "role": "user",
          "avatar": "user-icon-gray",
          "content": "Can you explain the waiting period for pre-existing conditions in the employee benefits section of this document?",
          "style": "blue-bubble"
        }
      ],
      "layout": "chat-thread"
    },
    {
      "name": "Quick Action Chips",
      "type": "other",
      "heading": "",
      "subheading": "",
      "items": ["Explain this policy", "Will this claim be rejected?", "Compare policies", "Explain waiting period", "Explain exclusions"],
      "layout": "flex-wrap-chips"
    },
    {
      "name": "Input Area",
      "type": "form",
      "heading": "",
      "subheading": "",
      "items": [],
      "layout": "bottom-fixed"
    }
  ],
  "footer": {
    "present": false
  },
  "forms": [
    {
      "name": "AI Query Input",
      "fields": [
        {
          "label": "",
          "type": "textarea",
          "placeholder": "Ask about policies, risk factors, or contract clauses...",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "submit_button_label": "Ask AI"
    }
  ],
  "buttons": [
    {
      "label": "Get Started",
      "style": "primary",
      "location": "header-right"
    },
    {
      "label": "Login",
      "style": "ghost",
      "location": "header-right"
    },
    {
      "label": "New Analysis",
      "style": "outline",
      "location": "sidebar-top"
    },
    {
      "label": "Ask AI",
      "style": "primary",
      "location": "input-area"
    }
  ],
  "icons": [
    "home-circle-outline",
    "target-outline",
    "lightbulb-outline",
    "scale-outline",
    "magnifier-outline",
    "check-circle-filled-blue",
    "plus-icon",
    "document-text-icon",
    "shield-check-icon",
    "arrows-left-right-icon",
    "bot-avatar-square-rounded",
    "user-avatar-circle",
    "paperclip-icon",
    "send-arrow-icon",
    "thumbs-up-icon",
    "copy-icon",
    "settings-gear-icon"
  ],
  "images": [],
  "animations_interactions": [
    "Chat bubbles appear with fade-in animation",
    "Typing indicator when AI is processing",
    "Hover states on quick action chips with subtle background change",
    "Button hover effects with slight scale or color darkening",
    "Sidebar items highlight on hover with light blue background"
  ],
  "responsive_cues": [
    "Sidebar collapses to hamburger menu on mobile",
    "Chat interface becomes full-width below 768px",
    "Breadcrumb steps become horizontally scrollable on small screens",
    "Input bar remains fixed at bottom of viewport on mobile"
  ],
  "notes": "The interface uses a clean, professional SaaS aesthetic typical of enterprise AI tools. The active step in the breadcrumb (Final Decision) is highlighted with a filled blue circle. The chat interface distinguishes between AI responses (white cards with blue icon) and user queries (solid blue rounded rectangles). The sidebar contains recent analysis history and suggested topic cards. User profile 'James Underwriter' appears at bottom left with settings gear."
}
